# Anne Shirley & Julia Bell

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md) — schoolmates who share friendly verses · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly grows fond of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities and Miss Stacy's project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>
